accepted_limitation: legacy_workspace_write_delete_is_limited_to_writable_roots is deliberately not selected. Its known boundary remains unresolved, not xfailed or converted into a passing security claim.
proof_boundary: Exactly 11 selected Rust cases in file_system_windows: the existing 9 native filesystem diagnostics plus one pure error check, followed by one explicitly ignored parent/helper baseline and follow-mode discriminator. Each inventory must match its exact expected ignored status. Both groups are serial, retries zero. Previously observed legacy/account groups are not rerun. The separate Python capture-helper self-tests are not part of this Rust population. No full workspace inventory/run, canonical package, installation or deployment. Passes may include explicitly reported unsupported-token early returns and do not establish full path coverage.
cleanup_boundary: Native, account, desktop and test-path ACL effects occur only on this disposable Windows 2025 VM. No extra provisioning, PID killing, force cleanup or global uninstall; the VM is discarded.
